metrics.label: Tree Count
metrics.description: Trees kept after confidence filtering (inside the AOI when one is given).

metrics.label: Average Confidence
metrics.description: Mean confidence of the counted detections (0.0-1.0).

metrics.label: Removed (Low Confidence)
metrics.description: Detections discarded by the confidence threshold.

metrics.label: Trees Outside AOI
metrics.description: Detections outside the AOI polygon. 0 when no AOI is given.

metrics.label: Analysis Area
metrics.description: AOI area, or the image ground footprint when no AOI is given.

metrics.label: Tree Density
metrics.description: tree_count divided by analysis_area_m2, in the unit given by tree_density_unit.
